reader.requirement: At --std 85 a FUNCTION REM reference whose argument-2 is zero at the time of reference is outside the permitted values and its result is undefined (§1989:A.2.2 AR4), so the compiler must accept every REM over class-numeric arguments and compute the §1989:A.2.37.4 remainder for every nonzero argument-2 (literal, item, ODO-table element, expression, negative, fraction, 18-digit), with any result (no host crash) for a zero divisor.

reader.notes: The 1985 text (Amendment 1 as corrected by Amendment 2) leaves a zero argument-2 undefined rather than requiring a diagnostic or an exception, so the runtime's checking-off substitute of 0 is conforming; nonzero divisors of every operand shape give the A.2.37.4 truncated remainder. The cite form §1985:A.2.37.3 fails cite.py (no-clause); the amendment is cited as §1989.

refuter.evidence: Read §1989:A.2.37.3 and §1989:A.2.2 in specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md (Amendment 2 correction C312 applied: an out-of-range argument value makes 'the result of such a reference' undefined; no diagnostic or exception is required). Probe refute-1985-172/q_rem_zero_arms.cob at --std 85 (runs/q_rem_zero_arms-002, exit 0) drives every runtime carrier a zero divisor can reach: REM(7 0) both literals (no compile-time fold crash) B1=0; REM(18-digit S9(18), COMP 0) B2=0; REM(S9(9)V9(9), COMP-3 0) B3=0; REM(.., SV9(9) 0) B4=0; REM(D7 D7 - D7) with ON SIZE ERROR B5=0 NOT ON SIZE ERROR; IF REM(D7 ZC) = 0 TRUE; INTEGER(REM(BIG 0.0)) B7=0; SUM(REM(D7 ZERO) 1.5) B8=1.5; REM(BIG * BIG, ZC) (wide carrier) B9=0; REM(BIGF / 3, ZF) B10=0; REM(BIGF, ZC ** 2) B11=0; DONE printed, no host exception on any arm. Runtime RemDec/RemExact/RemWide/RemReal/RemScaled all route b==0 to RemZeroDivisor. cite.py: 'OK §1989:A.2.37.3 AR2 (2.37.3 Arguments) the text is in AR2'; 'OK §1989:A.2.2 AR4 (2.2 ARGUMENTS**) the text is in AR4' (quoted 'then the result of such a reference is undefined').
